folders.contact_data: Raw input data for the case as delivered: historical snapshots from three providers (alfa CSV, beta JSONL, gama CSV) and the September contact-attempt log.
folders.contact_data/entregas_diarias/alfa: Daily delivery files from provider alfa (CSV, one per day of the month).
folders.contact_data/entregas_diarias/beta: Daily delivery files from provider beta (JSONL, one per day; some days missing).
folders.contact_data/entregas_diarias/gama: Daily delivery files from provider gama (CSV, one per day, plus a resend file for 2026-09-15).
folders: Project root: holds the case brief PDF and the contact_data/ inputs.
folders.docs: Public project documentation in pt-BR: source profile, ERD, modeling decisions and data dictionary
folders.ingestion: Python ingestion component: reads provider files per dataset config (conjuntos.yml) and lands them as Parquet with lineage columns
folders.landing/alfa_entregas: Landed Parquet of provider alfa daily deliveries, partitioned by dt_referencia (generated, git-ignored)
folders.landing/alfa_historico: Landed Parquet of provider alfa historical load (generated, git-ignored)
folders.landing/beta_entregas: Landed Parquet of provider beta daily deliveries, partitioned by dt_referencia (generated, git-ignored)
folders.landing/beta_historico: Landed Parquet of provider beta historical load (generated, git-ignored)
folders.landing/contatos_realizados: Landed Parquet of the September contact-attempt log (generated, git-ignored)
folders.landing/gama_entregas: Landed Parquet of provider gama daily deliveries incl. resends, partitioned by dt_referencia (generated, git-ignored)
folders.landing/gama_historico: Landed Parquet of provider gama historical load (generated, git-ignored)
folders.logs: Local run logs (dbt and pipeline output), not versioned
folders.macros: dbt macros: schema/alias name generation and shared SQL logic
